title: [P2][touch-target,polish] Sub-44px secondary controls: shopping-list row and onboarding wizard buttons
goal: Two unrelated but same-category polish gaps bundled together: the price Input and 'Log purchase' Button in shopping-list-item-row.tsx are both size='sm' (36px/32px), below the 44px target, while the row's primary checkbox is correctly size-11 (44px); and the Continue/Back/Skip/Finish buttons in app/onboarding/wizard.tsx use the default Button size (h-10, 40px), while login/signup already correctly use size='lg' (48px).
in_scope: Increase shopping-list-item-row.tsx's price Input and 'Log purchase' Button to at least 44px.
Increase app/onboarding/wizard.tsx's Continue/Back/Skip/Finish buttons to size='lg' (48px), matching login/signup's existing correct sizing.
out_of_scope: The shopping-list row's primary checkbox -- already correctly sized, not touched.
Any other button sizing outside these two specific locations.
acceptance: shopping-list-item-row.tsx's price Input and 'Log purchase' Button are at least 44px. app/onboarding/wizard.tsx's step-navigation buttons use size='lg' (48px), matching login/signup.
invariants: Layout must not break on narrow mobile widths after the size increase -- verify the shopping-list row still fits its content without wrapping awkwardly.
